versions.content: CanTSynGlobalTimeDebounceTime ( ECUC_CanTSyn_00045 : ) represents the debounce value of a PDU specific debounceCounter that shall be started after the Timesync PDU has been sent . Can TSyn shall decrement the debounceCounter value on each invocation of Can TSyn_M ainFunction() , if no Timesync PDU is transmitted .

CanTSynGlobalTimeDebounceTime ( ECUC_CanTSyn_00045 : ) represents the debounce value of a PDU specific debounceCounter that shall be started after the Timesync PDU has been successfully sent ( i.e., CanTSyn_TxConfirmation() fo r the corresponding PDU is called with parameter result set to E_OK ) . Can TSyn shall decrement the debounceCounter value on each invocation of Can TSyn_M ainFunction() , if no Timesync PDU is transmitted .

CanTSynGlobalTimeDebounceTime represents the de- bounce value of a PDU specific debounceCounter that shall be started after the Timesync PDU has been successfully sent (i.e., CanTSyn_TxConfirmation for the corresponding PDU is called with parameter result set to E_OK ). CanTSyn shall decrement the debounceCounter value on each invocation of CanTSyn_MainFunction
